description: Project savings with compound interest: an initial deposit plus monthly contributions (at the start or end of each month), a nominal annual rate compounded yearly, half-yearly, quarterly, monthly, daily or continuously, optionally adjusted for inflation ("today's money"). Returns final balance, total deposits, interest earned and a year-by-year table. Rate -50–100 %, 1 month to 100 years. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/compound-interest/

annualRate.description: Nominal annual interest rate in percent, e.g. 7.

inflation.description: Optional yearly inflation in percent, to show the balance in today's money.

timing.description: Contributions at the end (ordinary annuity) or start (annuity due) of each month.

years.description: Duration in years (fractions allowed, e.g. 1.5; at least one month).

name: calc_compound_interest
title: Compound interest / savings growth
